ws_routing_rules.content: Routing rules (worksheet ws_routing_rules): (1) Analytics issues -> team 'Analytics Support', tag 'product:analytics'. (2) Insights questions -> team 'Insights Support', tag 'product:insights'. (3) Automation/billing-on-Automation -> team 'Automation Support', tag 'product:automation'. (4) API/rate-limit -> team 'Platform/API', tag 'product:api'. (5) Workflow Builder issues -> team 'Workflow Support', tag 'product:workflow'. (6) Compliance/security doc requests (SOC2 etc) -> team 'Trust & Compliance', tag 'compliance'. (7) If customer's company is NOT entitled to the mentioned product, tag 'entitlement:none' and route to 'Sales Assist' instead of product team. (8) Anonymous/no-company visitors -> team 'Pre-sales', tag 'prospect'.

ws_overrides.content: Approved escalation overrides (worksheet ws_overrides), valid through 2026-06-30: OVR-114 Quantafleet -> all conversations route directly to 'Enterprise TAM (Lena Schultz)' regardless of product, tag 'tam:lena'. OVR-119 Verdant Health -> compliance requests fast-tracked to 'Trust & Compliance' with priority flag 'urgent'. OVR-121 Northbay Logistics -> SSO/login issues escalate to 'Identity Support' tag 'product:identity', overriding analytics routing.

support_policy_manual.content: Support policy manual excerpt: First-response SLA is 4 business hours for Starter/Growth, 1 hour for Enterprise. Tags must reflect verified entitlement, not customer claims. Routing summaries are posted to #support-routing only after a human owner confirms the routing plan. Customer-facing replies must use approved macros and never promise refunds or compliance documents without team confirmation.

team_channel_directory.content: Slack channel directory: #support-routing (routing summaries, 38 members), #support-eng (engineering escalations), #trust-compliance (compliance team), #pre-sales (prospect handoffs), #general. Posting handle for routing summaries: #support-routing.

tools.name: check_escalation_overrides

tools.name: apply_routing_rules
